answer: Reputation decay stops idle identity stockpiling. Every identity starts at 100 points. Each idle epoch costs 8 points. Below 60, rewards and voting weight stop. Honest work restores 6 points per epoch, capped at 100. The admission inlet filters new identities. Each pays a 40 copper stake before scoring starts. A karst audit probes history for hidden duplicate cavities before points accrue. Maintaining 1,000 clones costs 3,000 copper per epoch in upkeep. Skip one cycle and 8,000 points rot away. Forgery resets the score to 20 and freezes rewards for 6 epochs.
